name: Hirebrew / Handoff
status: Working identity direction. Trademark clearance pending.
websiteSystem: DM Sans, white canvas, dark-green actions and pastel product surfaces. Updated 14 October 2026.

canvas.role: Primary website canvas and white panels

action.role: Primary action background and text on secondary actions

softGreen.role: Supporting green surfaces and selected text highlight

secondaryAction.role: Secondary-action background; pair with action green

textSecondary.role: Secondary website text on white and light surfaces

border.role: Subtle surface separation; not a control boundary

controlBorder.role: Input outlines alongside persistent text labels

focus.role: Keyboard focus outline on light surfaces

pastel.role: Distinct product and supporting section surfaces; pair with website ink

artworkColor.usage: Original Handoff logo and connection-pattern artwork only. Preserve the supplied files; do not use coral as the website CTA colour.

typography.hosting: Self-hosted WOFF2 with font-display: swap. Bricolage Grotesque remains only in the outlined logo artwork, not website headings.

motion.reducedMotion: Disable nonessential motion and smooth scrolling

logo.clearSpace: At least one quarter of the visible symbol height on every side; measure from the artwork, not the SVG canvas
logo.wordmark: Bold outlined Bricolage Grotesque with optical spacing, under the SIL Open Font Licence; not a custom typeface

accessibility.focus: Visible 3px green outline with 5px offset on light surfaces; soft green on dark artwork specimens
